lab_and_purpose.purpose: Diagnostic testing results obtained prior to randomization that confirm HAE type I or II

evidence.quote: Diagnostic testing must be available for patients without genetic confirmation of HAE type I or II.

Diagnostic testing results obtained prior to randomization that confirm HAE type I or II: C1-INH functional level <40% of the normal level. Patients with functional C1-INH level 40-50% of the normal level may be enrolled if they also have a C4 level below the normal range. Testing may be obtained from central or local laboratories or obtained from documented historical testing results.

measurements.name: Vital Signs
measurements.position_or_condition: after the patient has been at rest for at least 5 minutes
measurements.units: mmHg; beats per minute; breaths per minute

evidence.quote: Vital signs will be assessed after the patient has been at rest for at least 5 minutes in accordance with the Schedule of Events (Table 1). Vital signs will include blood pressure (systolic blood pressure [SBP] and diastolic blood pressure [DBP]; mmHg), pulse rate (PR; beats per minute), and respiration rate ([RR] breaths per minute).
Vital signs include pulse rate, respiratory rate, and systolic and diastolic blood pressure after patient has been resting at least 5 minutes.

notes: Single protocol version in the PDF: KVD900-301 Version 4.1 (US Only), 04 May 2023 (title page lists earlier versions 3.1, 3.0, 2.0, 1.0 by date only); the SoA (Table 1, pp17-18) is from this version. The amendment summary (p4, Version 3.1 to 4.1) changes inclusion criterion 6a and statistical analyses only; nothing for an SoA activity or a category here. cross_references: empty because soa_cross_references is empty; SoA note r (PGI-S, PGI-C, VAS, GA-NRS) points to 'Table S1' (Frequency of Patient Assessment, synopsis p11), which the body repeats as Table 4 (p42) - not an input item, so not recorded as a cross-reference. Pages read from images: p43 (Table 5 Laboratory Assessments, two panel pairs per row) checked visually - the text layer's panel grouping matches the image, no assignment changed; p19 (no text layer, Key Contact List) gives Central Laboratory = PPD Laboratories US (one evidence entry marked page image); p46 (no text layer, sections 15.7.2-15.8 SAE reporting and Pregnancy) has nothing for these categories (HED and NOAEL appear there but are already in the abbreviation list). Panels: specimen per panel is not stated in Table 5 except Pregnancy test (serum); 14.3.4 (p42) says blood samples approximately 40 mL, and the visit lists (pp49, 52) say blood and urine samples for clinical laboratory tests. Lab = central laboratory from SoA note m and p42 for the Safety Laboratory row; the Pregnancy Test row has no lab stated beyond its place in Table 5. Table 5 footnote defines WBC as 'white blood cell differential, immature granulocytes' while the abbreviation list gives 'white blood cell'. Conflicts / differing wording: HAE diagnostic testing may come from central or local laboratories or documented historical results (p31/p12) while SoA note m says laboratory assessments including C1-INH functional level are performed by a central laboratory; VAS is 'visual analog scale' (SoA p18, synopsis p14) vs 'visual analogue scale' (list p22, p24); GA-NRS is 'Modified General Anxiety – Numeric Rating Scale' (p15, 'Modified GA-NRS' p41) vs 'General Anxiety Numeric Rating Scale' (p27) and 'General Anxiety – Numeric Rating Scale' (p18, p20); PGI-S is a '5-point rating scale' (p41) and a '5-point Likert scale' (p60); RTSM = 'Randomization Trial Supply Management System' (p18) vs 'Randomization and Trial Supply Management System' (p21, p36); vital signs: 'respiratory rate' (SoA note l) vs 'respiration rate' (p42), and pp48/52 say only BP and PR are recorded after 5 minutes rest; ECG RR-interval unit printed as 'seconds [ms]' (p42); abbreviation list has rhC1-INH while the text uses rC1-INH (p11, p38); medical history in 14.1 adds 'COVID-19 trials' compared with SoA note h. Instruments: recall_period values are the time frame in the printed questions ('right now'); eDiary frequency of assessment is Table S1 (p11) / Table 4 (p42). The AE severity grading scale (p45) is recorded for Adverse Event Review. All SoA activity name tokens (HAE, ECG, RTSM, IMP, PGI-S, PGI-C, VAS, GA-NRS) are defined in the abbreviation list. Every SoA row is described in the body text; 'Conventional on-demand treatment washout' only through SoA note o and section 12.2 (p38). Abbreviations: complete list pp20-22 plus the SoA table footnote (p18) and the Table 5 footnote (p43), recorded with their own pages including duplicates with differing definitions.
